## API Connection
```{r}
faostat_login(
  username = "ikimhor",
  password = "jIwvuv-woqwad-5ruxqu")

df_security <- get_faostat_bulk(code = "FS")
data_folder <- "data_raw"
if(!dir.exists(data_folder)) dir.create(data_folder)

df_security <- get_faostat_bulk(code = "FS", data_folder = data_folder)
df_fbs_curr <- get_faostat_bulk(code = "FBS", data_folder = data_folder)
df_fbs_hist <- get_faostat_bulk(code = "FBSH", data_folder = data_folder)
df_crops    <- get_faostat_bulk(code = "QCL", data_folder = data_folder)
```

## API Data Cleaning
```{r}
df_security_clean <- df_security %>%
  mutate(
    item_code = as.integer(item_code),
    value = as.numeric(value),
    year = as.numeric(substr(year, 1, 4))
  )

analysis_df <- bind_rows(
    df_security_clean,
    df_fbs_curr %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)),
    df_fbs_hist %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)),
    df_crops %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year))
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(year))
```
